algebro_geometric_mobility_criterion: For either explicit curvilinear a=0 or a=1 cluster, H0(dH-sum(m_iE_i)) is the exact kernel of the forbidden Laurent/low-jet coefficient matrix after successive blow-up substitution.  A second kernel vector whose plane form is coprime to the affine wall product and has the exact assigned multiplicity sequence gives a disjoint fibre and hence a base-point-free cusp pencil.
algebro_geometric_vinberg_criterion: For a complete rational-surface Coxeter nef cone, Vinberg's ideal endpoint condition is witnessed inside Pic(X) by a full-rank orthogonal union of affine configurations of negative curves; each primitive affine null cycle is the nef isotropic cusp class.
claim: Every ideal vertex of the complete P12--P16 rational-surface nef chambers is a primitive effective isotropic divisor reconstructed exactly from each connected affine wall component.  All twenty-eight cusp classes on each of the non-isomorphic explicit a=0 and a=1 carriers are certified semiample: twenty-seven move in their primitive class, while the remaining primitive system is rigid and has exact first moving multiple |4F|.
